A large blank circle floats above a toilet while a standing person reaches toward its bowl. The circle has no visible attachment and its role is unclear; the small dot near the hand does not resolve the action.

## Visual draft

A standing person extends one arm toward a side view toilet on the left. A large detached circle floats above the toilet, while a tiny dot sits between the hand and bowl.

## Open question

What does the floating circle represent, and is the person dropping an object or demonstrating a different action? Do not invent a prohibition mark or contents.

## 1. Standing person reaching left (solo)

A round headed standing person extends one arm to the left beside a straight torso and divided legs. Exclude the toilet and detached circle.

## 2. Side view toilet (solo)

A toilet in side view has a tall cistern and a curved bowl projecting right above a narrow lower support. Exclude the person, detached circle, and tiny dot.
